output: An in-process cache does not need a network call, but each worker keeps its own copy, so one worker can give an older value than another. A shared cache depends on the network and adds another service to run, but workers can look at the same entry. For this read-only dashboard, updates that arrive up to 60 seconds late are okay, so I recommend the in-process option for now. Do not use that recommendation for permission checks, where an old allow decision could grant access after permission was revoked. Look at this choice again if dashboard freshness must be tighter; a shared cache alone does not guarantee fresh reads.
